authority: C++ source and Authoring/ability_codex.json remain mechanical/ability references; this ledger is the enforceable cross-system index. UE runtime not verified.

policy.discovery: Must be physically earned and sourced; testimony is not omniscience.
policy.choices: Exclusive care/truth and defeat/mercy state must never both resolve the same quest.
policy.rewards: A story promise is not a catalog item; regional gear and techniques use independent earned ownership.
policy.aftermath: Save-backed, local, witnessed, visible after returning; never erase prior quests or chosen player identity.
policy.open_mysteries: Open mysteries remain open unless deliberately approved in new canon.

exceptions.description: Rite prose says The Unpaid Sunrise; milestone grants FutureReceipt, Tomorrow's Paid Receipt. Do not silently rewrite story or source.

bosses.name: The Collector of Unborn Days
bosses.access: Complete quest:echo:TidalLedger and approach the guardian; nonlethal choice requires nearby line of sight.
attacks: The collector unwinds a future chain; step beyond the arc or Fold its strike.
resolutions: Double-confirm mercy pact after witnessed Echo
aftermath: The ferry keeps the collector's chains as proof no child's future may be pledged.
The published record names those who forged debts in another person's time.

attacks: The invisible note tightens; break sight, guard, or Fold before it falls.
resolutions: Double-confirm mercy pact after witnessed Echo
aftermath: The new meter counts the erased singer among willing supporters.
The open stage gives a name to the voice the council denied.

quests.name: A Bell That Had No Last Note
quests.entry: Why does the Crossings bell ring from a road that no one has walked?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: In Bellwold a refugee remembers a bell that has never been cast. In Paperhaven its absence has a signed record. Neither settlement can prove the other wrong.

quests.name: The Shore Without Its Water
quests.entry: Who can remember a sea that is missing without owning the grief of those left ashore?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Sella's sea chart is not an error. The rain preserved a record of something intentionally withheld, and the debt dates are written in another city's script.

quests.name: The Heat Lent By No Sun
quests.entry: Who keeps a common flame burning when the sun whose gift it was never existed?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Tarin reads a fire with the same missing second found in the bell. The city's warmth survives because someone accepted a cost they did not create.

quests.name: The Account That Borrowed Tomorrow
quests.entry: Can a debt be legitimate when its signatory has not been born?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Veynu's impossible dates show that the world's missing things were pledged as collateral; a contract is written on the underside of reality itself.

quests.name: The Chorus That Holds The Roof
quests.entry: How many people were removed from history to keep a single hanging street above the ground?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Yllesh's missing voice proves that the same absences are doing work in several realms. The common pattern is a decision, not an accident.

quests.name: The Stone That Remembered Workers
quests.entry: When a family is mined out of time, who gets to call its descendants fictional?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Ghraet's seams show erased lineages in the mountain's living load. Someone has been converting impossible people into stable places.

quests.name: The Census Of Those Not Born
quests.entry: Can a person be a valid witness without having a beginning recognized by the city?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Eillun's unentered people are not echoes; they live and disagree. A missing origin is not evidence that someone deserves to be erased.

quests.name: The Crown Nobody Accepted
quests.entry: Who has been enforcing the world's oldest rule after every prospective ruler refused it?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Tharniv's root-court remembers a law signed by nobody. Its force survived because an answering consciousness was made responsible for every unresolved question.

quests.name: The Answer With No Question
quests.entry: Why does the first witness remember a traveler who has not yet arrived?
choices: Resolve eligible chapter and follow one of its supported alternate routes
aftermath: Auvren reveals a seam older than either origin. Nhal-Vey did not create the contradictions; it has been eating the questions people were afraid to ask.

aftermath: The public crossing remains open after dark.
Hidden toll histories become public records.

choices: Keep the lantern reserve on the refuge road
Publish the excluded names and reserve the archive room
aftermath: We will keep a bed ready. Jessa still asks why the list is folded shut.
The names are posted. I have moved a lantern indoors; the outer road will need your field kit.
quests.evidence: The torn charter lists both the abandoned beds and a reserve of lantern oil. Neither claim cancels the other.

aftermath: Valves and charts persist; repair changes roads and local dialogue, with day-bounded recovery and no infinite weak-foe loot.

quests.name: Water For Those Still Waiting
quests.entry: Decide who controls the recovered pump schedule.
choices: Guarantee a protected family water hour
Keep access public and post every withdrawal
aftermath: Havin keeps the protected hour. The provisioner charges less; travelers wait until the bell.
The withdrawal sheet is public. We spend more time checking it, but newcomers can ask for water.
quests.evidence: A soaked schedule shows the pumps stopped before the tanks were empty. A private water hour could preserve a reserve or become another gate.

The meter is where everyone can read it. The houses keep their blankets; the rescue crew keeps its heat.
quests.evidence: A service diagram separates the domestic line from a guarded emergency reservoir. Both share the same limited intake.

Expose the whole oath and renegotiate it publicly

The oath is being read aloud. Some people trust us more; others will not wait for the negotiation.
quests.evidence: A copied oath distinguishes the voluntary family promise from the collector's added liability. The ink layers can be read separately.

Open the crossing record and use manual load watches

The record is open. Liora has asked for another watcher, because reading it does not hold a bridge up.
quests.evidence: The anchor records footsteps as well as load. Its structural use does not require retaining a named crossing record.

The neighboring names are on the wall. Aren has had to defend our claim in front of people it once excluded.
quests.evidence: The seam copy carries a family claim and several neighboring names. The claimant's stamp covers both, rather than establishing either as false.

quests.evidence: The storehouse sheet accepts household totals without personal names. An attached index would identify each person if it were retained.

The path is common again. Sivra takes the first watch and cannot ask Alva to carry every hungry season alone.
